title: Reconnecting After a Long Estrangement
paragraphs: After nearly eight years of estrangement following a bitter inheritance dispute, Wildan received an unexpected message from his estranged brother, offering a tentative apology neither of them had felt ready to extend years earlier.

Rather than responding with the accumulated resentment of nearly a decade, Wildan chose to arrange a cautious meeting, deliberately setting aside the specific grievances that had originally caused their falling out.
The initial reunion felt genuinely awkward, with both brothers uncertain how to address years of silence without reopening wounds that time had only partially healed on either side.

Two years later, having rebuilt a considerably more modest but genuine relationship, Wildan reflects that reconciliation required both brothers accepting an imperfect resolution rather than continuing to wait for a complete, ideal resolution that likely would never arrive.
